nom: Philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker Fix Eye Power-Treatment Fill & Firm

segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, or who apply it to the naturally sensitive under-eye area, report no irritation at all, but one reviewer says it burned her eyes twice and left her under-eye area newly sensitive, despite never having problems with eye creams before.
segments.oily: The one reviewer who addresses oily skin advises against daytime use for that skin type, since the cream is on the heavier side.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s through 60s and beyond consistently report smoother, firmer, more youthful-looking skin around the eyes, several specifically recommending it to older users dealing with hollows or crepiness.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers report visibly smoother, firmer skin with fewer fine lines and less crepiness around the eyes, often within one to a few weeks, and several older reviewers specifically credit it with a more youthful look; however, a meaningful number report no visible difference even after weeks of use, and one describes the appearance of smoothness as a temporary film that peels off and leaves eyes looking worse within two hours.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the treatment as lightweight yet hydrating for the delicate eye area, but one reviewer says it doesn't provide enough moisturization for her surrounding eye tissue.
concerns.redness: The one reviewer who reports on redness says the treatment made the area under her eyes redder rather than improving it.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers who mention dark circles say they became noticeably lighter or disappeared with regular use, but one reviewer says the brightening effect is only a temporary film that wears off within two hours, leaving her with more visible dark circles and bags than before.

aspects.libelle: Can pill or flake under makeup
Pump can be inconsistent or wasteful
A little goes a long way

extraits.texte: This product is expensive, it promises a lot and it doesn't really do anything, at first it leaves you with very nice dark circles, it seems as if you had a filter, you look fabulous, but when the effect wears off you are left with more dark circles and bags under your eyes. They look flabby, also during the day without waiting much it starts to peel off as if you were shedding your skin and that's the trick, that thin layer that makes your eyes look beautiful is just a curtain of lies, the effect doesn't last even two hours. and how much it costs, I definitely won't buy it again

I hardly ever return products, but this had to go back!! It was too pricey to burn my eyes 2 times and had me not be able to wear any eye products when I went to the gym because of the extreme irritation. My undereye got sooo sensitive!! I would not recommend this product at all!! I usually have no problems with eye creams and I've tried dozens over my lifetime.

extraits.titre: Feels nice as far as moisturizing
extraits.texte: After using this regularly for a month I'm not too sure that it did much more than moisturize my skin well and MAYBE brighten my undereyes slightly. I didn't see any improvement in the little wrinkles or the creases around my eyes when i smile. Not sure that I would purchase it again after using what Influenster sent me for this review. Always so grateful though!

extraits.titre: Brighter, Smoother Eyes with Philosophy Ultimate M
extraits.texte: I've been using the Philosophy Ultimate Miracle Worker Fix Serum Eye Power Treatment consistently, and I'm very impressed with the results. The packaging is sleek, hygienic, and easy to use, making it perfect for daily application. The serum has a very light, clean aroma that isn't overpowering at all, which I really appreciate around the eye area. The texture is silky and absorbs quickly without feeling greasy or heavy. I noticed my under-eye area looks smoother, more hydrated, and brighter over time, with no irritation or skin reaction at all—even on my sensitive skin. A little goes a long way, so the product lasts a long time, making it feel like a great value. Overall, this eye treatment feels gentle yet effective, and it fits perfectly into my skincare routine.
I like this product….but, It does not offer enough moisturization to my surrounding eye tissue.

extraits.titre: Best eye cream I've tried in awhile
extraits.texte: This eye cream is excellent. It is a heavier cream that I wouldn't recommend for day time use for those with oily skin. It is super moisturizing and seems to visibly lessen fine line around the eyes as soon as it is applied. Over about a 6 week period of time I could tell a difference. It has no scent that I can determine and the packaging is quite handy to use.

This works..I been using this product for the first time..It does fill in the areas as I aged to smooth out the hollow that I recently noticed ..needed attentio. This does help to fill in ..Because I am older ..I would definetly recomend this eye cream Philosophy..Thank you!
